out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO SIGNED COPIES ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC . PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH EMPLOYEE SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW CHICKEN AND RAW BEEF STORED ABOVE COOKED CHICKEN AND NOODLES IN MIGALI 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.; RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED DISHES AND UTENSILS WASHED IN DISHWASHING MACHINE WITH SANITIZER CONCENTRATION MEASURED AT 0PPM. EHS OBSERVED NO SANITIZER FOR DISHWASHING MACHINE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO SANITIZE DISHES. PIC ORDER CHLORINE SANITIZER FOR DISHWASHING MACHINE DURING INSPECTION. HALAL HUNAN VILLAGE (Inspection Date: 06/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF SALT, SUGAR, SPICES, OILS AND SAUCES ON CART NEAR WOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE INITIATED APPLYING LABELS ON WORKING CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MICE DROPPINGS IN DRY STORAGE AREAS AND SHELVING AND END OF COOK LINE IN KITCHEN. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES IN KITCHEN AREA. NO CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE REPORT WAS AVAILABLE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AFFECTED AREAS AND PROVIDE CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR AND MIDDLE OF FRONT MAIN ENTRANCE DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL DOOR SWEEPS AND SEALS TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PEST.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: COUNTERS, SHELVING AND REFRIGERATION UNITS
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS in the KITCHEN ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THAT A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF COOK LINE AND NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE being used TO STORE UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: FOODS PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING: COOKED LAMB, COOKED CHICKEN, CHICK PEAS, LENTILS, BEEF, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control (TPHC) with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): OBSERVED TPHC DOCUMENTATION INCONSISTENTLY AND INACCURATELY MAINTAINED FOR FOODS ON BUFFET LINE.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC UPDATED RECORDS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap dispensers at each handwashing sink was not dispensing at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Education provided. PIC provided soap for handwashing during inspection. Please ensure hand soap is available at all times for handwashing.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: TANDOORI CHICKEN AT 119F, VEGETABLE EGG ROLL AT 121F; JALFREZI CHICKEN AT 121F ON BUFFET LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' (TPHC) as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REHEATED TANDOORI AND JALFREZI CHICKEN DURING INSPECTION. EGG ROLL WAS PLACED ON TIME TO BE DISCARDED AT 5:00 PM. PIC WILL GOING FORWARD USE TPHC PROCEDURES FOR FOODS ON BUFFET AND MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MIXED SALAD AT 43F, CHICK PEAS SALAD AT 44F, STUFFED GRAPE LEAVES AT 48F, MANGO MOUSSE AT 48F, SAWINE AT 44F ON COLD BUFFET LINE; RICE AT 44F, CHICKEN BIRYANI AT 44F, CHICK PEAS AT 44F, SPINACH AT 44F AND EGG PLANT AT 44F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED FOODS ON BUFFET COLD LINE ON TIME FOR DISCARD AT 5:00 PM; EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS HELD IN THE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AT 44F, TCS FOODS WERE AT 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F.
